newsitem.title: USA: U.S. attorney subpoenas Texaco documents.
newsitem.headline: U.S. attorney subpoenas Texaco documents.

text.p: The U.S. attorney for the Southern District of New York has issued a subpoena to Texaco Inc seeking documents related to racial discrimination allegations by six African-American employees.
In a quarterly filing on Wednesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Texaco said the subpoena was in connection with a March 1994 suit brought by the employees.
In the suit the employees alleged that the company fostered a hostile environment since early 1991. The plantiffs are seeking damages totaling $71 million.
The employees had earlier filed a motion for sanctions alleging that Texaco concealed or withheld documents they had requested. A hearing is scheduled for November 22.
Transcripts of tapes recorded in 1994 surfaced recently. In the tapes, Texaco executives allegedly discussed destroying evidence and used expletives and racist terms.
